description: Typed-degradation matrix. Each cell describes what the report HTML should contain when the named fetcher is wired in the V1.1 pipeline but returns the named failure mode. The consumer-facing text is short enough to fit a banner / warning / info box. The `section_id` is where the message is expected to appear. The `degradation_tag` is the typed tag the section_validators accept as a substitute for the missing data point.

rccms.label: RCCMS Odisha Revenue Court (ccms.nic.in v2.0)
rccms.v11_special_handling: V1.2 (2026-06-17, Task 1.1): added v2-ccms-nic fetcher in parallel with the existing rccms probe. ccms.nic.in is reachable (HTTP 200, JSESSIONID set) and /searchCases.html exists. Captcha solving currently fails — solveCaptcha() with useOnnx:false falls back to ddddocr (generic OCR) which does not match this portal's captcha; the ONNX model referenced by the plan does not exist yet (Task 0.3 stub). When captcha solving fails the fetcher returns status='manual_required' (honest non-fire), the existing rccms probe stays the production path until v2 can clear the captcha end-to-end.

failure_modes.source_down: Fetcher returned a network error, 5xx response, or threw an unhandled exception. Status == 'failed' or status == 'error'.
failure_modes.no_data: Fetcher returned a successful response (status == 'success') but the payload was empty or had no records matching the search.
failure_modes.invalid_input: Fetcher rejected the input as malformed before running. This is a pre-payment user error — surface it in the input form, not in the report.
failure_modes.parse_error: Fetcher returned a successful HTTP response but the parser could not extract structured data. Status == 'partial' with parser error.
